basics.name: Zoha Rakotomalala
basics.label: Software Development Engineer @ Amazon
basics.summary: Software engineer at Amazon with a business-school background (EDHEC, UC Berkeley Haas, SKKU). Largely self-taught technically: took every data/CS-adjacent course available, filled the gaps deliberately, and moved from data-analyst internships into software engineering via Dataiku and Amazon. Comfortable with ambiguity, drawn to hard problems and new technologies. Experience across fullstack development (Java, TypeScript), AWS infrastructure-as-code, A/B experimentation, and cross-team coordination on pricing and legal-compliance features for European marketplaces.

work.name: Amazon
work.summary: Operational excellence and infrastructure modernization in a team owning cross-marketplace seller pricing services, enabling margin-neutral price automation across global Amazon storefronts.
highlights: Migrated and decommissioned legacy AWS resources as part of a broader infrastructure modernization effort, improving maintainability and reducing operational overhead
Developed and deployed infrastructure-as-code solutions with AWS CDK, deepening expertise in cloud-native architecture patterns and AWS best practices
Contributed to services powering automated, margin-neutral pricing for sellers expanding across international marketplaces

work.name: Amazon
work.summary: Fullstack development (Java, TypeScript, internal Amazon stacks) in a team owning price transparency and legal compliance features for European marketplaces.
highlights: Expanded the Omnibus directive compliance feature to the Spanish market via an A/B experiment, owning the full launch lifecycle from design to post-launch analysis
Authored the post-mortem after a legal compliance incident during the Spain launch: root cause analysis across interconnected systems, mitigation items driven to resolution
Designed the architecture for a new price history customer experience, weighing real-time computation against pre-computed approaches for latency and scalability
Identified and documented latency regression correction opportunities in the price tracker service, contributing to reliability improvements
Coordinated across three engineering teams and senior stakeholders to align technical standards and surface experiment overlap, leading to strategic project consolidation
Redesigned a core UI component of the price tracker feature to be scalable and reusable across marketplaces and languages
Presented at an internal Amazon conference in Madrid on Model Context Protocol (MCP) and its architectural implications for AI-integrated systems
Supervised a software engineering intern for 5 months: technical mentorship, design reviews, guidance on an internal operations dashboard
Served as team happiness champion, owning the cycle of team feedback surveys, analysis and action-item follow-through
Held on-call responsibilities for production systems, ensuring reliability and rapid incident response

work.name: Dataiku
work.summary: Built end to end a ~1900-line feature generating and displaying foreign-key relation graphs between database tables.
highlights: Indexed primary and foreign keys via JDBC into an ElasticSearch store
Generated graph templates in Java and rendered them through Graphviz

Post-processed the SVG in Angular/TypeScript: mass import of tables, expand/collapse of relation degrees, external table preview, zoom/pan navigation, tooltips, clustering into schema zones, state persistence across modal sessions, connected-column highlighting

work.name: Dashlane
work.summary: Data analysis and visualization on Tableau over SQL Server and Amazon Redshift; communicated insights and recommended actions to stakeholders.
highlights: Analysed the account creation flow during a New Product Introduction to detect drop-off points
Analysed sales and trial engagement touchpoints to explain month-over-month performance variations
Built a data model tracking the daily evolution of customers in trial
Built a model predicting user retention to guide the sales team
Owned QA of several data models, cross-checking Salesforce against back-office data and proposing matching improvements

work.name: Spark.do
work.summary: Data analysis and reporting on Metabase over PostgreSQL; maintenance of the data pipeline and reportings.
highlights: Wrote and maintained KPI queries and reportings, debugging and fixing broken reports
Improved and maintained the data pipeline
Contributed to roadmap projects and internal trainings
Tools: Metabase, PostgreSQL, Python, JavaScript, Pipedream, Airtable
